title: Snail eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground/leaf base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='42' ry='10' fill='#2e7d32'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='42' ry='9' fill='#43a047'/>
  <!-- leaf vein -->
  <path d='M18 80 Q50 72 82 80' stroke='#81c784' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  
  <!-- snail body -->
  <path d='M20 78 Q15 68 25 62 Q35 56 45 62 L45 78 Z' fill='#f9a825'/>
  <path d='M20 78 Q15 70 24 64 Q32 59 42 63' fill='none' stroke='#fdd835' stroke-width='2'/>
  
  <!-- snail head -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='62' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#f9a825'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='60' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#fdd835'/>
  
  <!-- eye stalks -->
  <path d='M24 54 Q22 46 20 42' stroke='#f9a825' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M32 54 Q34 46 36 42' stroke='#f9a825' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='41' r='3.5' fill='#ffee58'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='41' r='3.5' fill='#ffee58'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='41' r='1.8' fill='#4e342e'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='41' r='1.8' fill='#4e342e'/>
  
  <!-- cute smile -->
  <path d='M24 66 Q28 70 33 66' stroke='#e65100' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='65' r='2.5' fill='#ff8a65' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- snail shell -->
  <circle cx='60' cy='58' r='22' fill='#6d4c41'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='58' r='22' fill='none' stroke='#8d6e63' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M60 58 Q60 46 70 46 Q80 46 80 56 Q80 66 70 68 Q58 70 56 58 Q54 44 66 40 Q78 37 82 48' fill='none' stroke='#a1887f' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='58' r='5' fill='#a1887f'/>
  
  <!-- snack: a little green leaf/cucumber slice being eaten -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='70' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#66bb6a' transform='rotate(-15 40 70)'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='70' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#a5d6a7' transform='rotate(-15 40 70)'/>
  <!-- bite mark -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='69' r='2.5' fill='#fdd835'/>
  
  <!-- little sparkles for cuteness -->
  <path d='M85 45 l1 3 l3 1 l-3 1 l-1 3 l-1 -3 l-3 -1 l3 -1 z' fill='#fff176'/>
  <path d='M15 52 l0.7 2 l2 0.7 l-2 0.7 l-0.7 2 l-0.7 -2 l-2 -0.7 l2 -0.7 z' fill='#fff176'/>
</svg>
